newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 91-day t-bill average yield 6.196 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 91-day t-bill average yield 6.196 pct.

text.p: Bank Negara Malaysia said on Thursday it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.196 percent at its auction of 91-day treasury bills for 80 million ringgit.
At its previous auction of 91-day treasury bills on June 12 for 100 million ringgit, the average yield was 6.483 percent.
The bids accepted were in the high/low range of 6.295/179 percent against 6.533/435 percent previously.
The central bank also said it accepted bids for 364-day treasury bills of 100 million ringgit at an average 6.168 percent against 6.365 percent on June 19.
The bids accepted were in the high/low range of 6.180/148 percent against 6.375/347 percent previously.
Bank Negara said it will hold the next auction of 182-day treasury bills for 100 million ringgit on July 10.
